hooks.text: owes a life-debt to the person they betrayed
is one payment behind on a ship the Hutts still consider theirs
smuggled refugees out of a falling system and never told anyone what it cost
carries a dead partner's manifest with one delivery left on it
knows where a warlord's payroll went down and hasn't spent a credit of it
took a retrieval job and returned the fee after meeting the target
keeps a bounty puck with their own face on it
testified against a crime family and has moved eleven times since
found something in a sealed Imperial cache that should have stayed sealed
runs a legitimate business exactly one ledger deep
mustered out with a medal and an unanswered court-martial question
served under an officer now wanted for war crimes and said nothing
is the only surviving witness to how the outpost really fell
still files reports to a New Republic office that stopped reading them
defected from the Imperial Remnant with a head full of fleet codes
promised a dying squadmate to find the family the war scattered
was decorated for an order they have regretted every day since
keeps rebuilding a hometown militia the Senate keeps defunding
intercepted a signal proving the war is not as over as advertised
trained the recruit who later burned everything down
hears the Force clearest in the moments they are most afraid
walked out of a dark-side site the rest of the survey team never left
was flagged by an Imperial screening office that no longer officially exists
carries a lightsaber they have never explained to anyone
turned down a place at the Praxeum and has dreamed about it every night since
made a promise to a dying Jedi whose name they never learned
can feel when someone is lying and wishes they couldn't
was raised on stories that turn out to have been warnings
protected a Force-sensitive child by teaching them to hide it
felt the moment a distant world died and cannot make anyone believe it

flaws.text: cannot stop keeping score of who owes whom
lies smoothest to the people they most want to keep
treats every kindness as a debt coming due
would rather lose everything than ask twice
trusts machines more than anyone with a pulse
keeps a list of names they have not forgiven, starting with their own
answers fear with a joke and always one beat too late
cannot walk past a locked door without wondering
still measures every room for exits before sitting down
makes promises faster than any lifetime could keep
mistakes being needed for being loved
holds a grudge with the patience of a glacier
spends money like the future is someone else's problem
believes the rules apply to everyone else first
goes quiet exactly when the truth would help
never learned the difference between loyalty and obedience
would follow a bad plan off a cliff before admitting doubt
drinks the fear down and calls it steadiness
cannot resist a fight that is none of their business
forgives everyone except the person in the mirror
